title: 5. Editor tier (L)
description:
Shipped story: ship-9890b5 (editor tier). Size L. Depends on stories 3 and 4.

As an editor, I want to approve, decline and override, so that readers steer but editors keep the final say, in public.

Acceptance criteria:
- Approve, decline, pin and hold on Proposals.
- Override requires a public reason; both the community result and the override result stay visible.
- Batch vote exclusion (for example accounts under 24h old), with undo and a public 'excluded N' note.
- Mark an account spam or limited.
- A 'needs a look' filter: vote spikes, new-account surges, community-vs-AI disagreement.
- Only editors can use these actions; others are refused.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
